name: Classic chess with SAN history
content: Play orthodox chess on an 8x8 board. Choose your own move. You may explain your choice. End the answer with one canonical SAN move, using the same notation as accepted moves in the history. Include required disambiguation, capture, promotion, and check/checkmate suffixes. Castling uses O-O or O-O-O. Nothing may follow the final move. The current FEN and ASCII position are authoritative; do not reconstruct the position from memory.
